tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// khyung nag me yi spu gri 'bar ba'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

ras chung lugs/ ༄༅// na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa// rdo rje mkha' lding dbang po la btud nas// de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa mchog /dam pa'i man ngag ji bzhin spel bar bya// 'dir khyung nag me yi spu gri'i gdams pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las dug gi rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su/ mthong dug reg dug tshor dug sogs dug rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dug gi rwa ba gru bzhi'i steng du/ pad nyi gdan gsum gi khri brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ rang nyid rdo rje mkha' lding nag po gnam lcags kyi mchu sder can/ rtsa ba rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ rtse mo rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rang bzhin 'bar ba'i rwa gnyis kyi dbus su nor bus mtshan pa/ gser mig 'khyil pa nyi ltar 'bar ba/ zhal dung so ngar mas gang zhing*/ gshog pa rdo rje'i ri mo can las me'i tshwa tshwa 'bum phrag 'phro ba/ mgrin pa nas pus mo'i bar mi'i rnam pa la/ rkang pa bya'i sder mo can/ phyag gnyis kyi gdug pa can thams cad la sdigs par mdzad pa/ sku las me mdag 'phro pa'i gnam lcags dang khyung du ma phyogs bcur 'phro bas sa bdag thams cad brgyal zhing dngangs par byed pa'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug bya/ oṃ ga ru ḍā sogs kyis mchod/ stong gsum g.yo ba'i gshog sgro yis// gar mdzad 'bar ba'i mchu sder can// dran pa tsam gyis gdon gsum kun// tshar gcod mkha' lding dbang por bstod// de nas snying ga'i sngags phreng las 'od zer bskal pa'i me phung ltar 'phros pas brtan g.yo thams cad me 'bar ba'i rang bzhin du gyur/ steng 'og bar gsum gyi gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ ma ṇi khyung khyung*/

thum thum rbad rbad swā hā/ zhes pa zhi ba'i sngags cung zad bzlas nas/ nag po kā la rak+ṣa rbad rbad/ sod sod/ phyung phyung*/ sbu gri zang zang*/ lcags kyi sder mos snying phyung*/ gnod byed gdug pa'i sha la zo/ oṃ lhang lhang*/ tser tser/ 'ub 'ub sod/ ces gang mang bzla zhing*/ mjug tu dge ba bsngo/ nad pa sra 1 ུnga na/ rang khyung du gsal zhing sngags mang du bzlas nas nad pa'i gnas gsum du btab pas phan no// 'dzag pa 2 srung na/ gu gul gyis sngags dbu can bris/ rang sngags kyis rab gnas byas/ thum nag pos dril nas gdags/ sngags bzlas pa'i mchil mas dpral mgrin snying ga lte gsang rnams su byugs pas phan no// 'dre gdon gyi gnod pa 3 srung na/ srung skud nag po mdud pa bdun rgyags/ mdud pa re'i nang du khyung re bzhugs par bsam/ rang khyung du gsal bas 'dogs/ shin tu zab/ ser ba 4 srung na/ bdag bskyed gsal bas sngags bzlas phus btab pas nam mkha' khyung gis gang zhing*/ khyung rnams las me 'bar bas ser ba chur zhu/ yang khyung nam mkha' gang ba bsgrigs nas ser ba phyogs gzhan du bskrad par bsam mo// 'di'i phan yon ni/ gag lhog gzer gsum/ 'brum pa/ mdze/ phol mig sogs 'og gdon sa bdag klu'i gnod pa dang*/ steng gdon gza'i gnod pa sogs mi 'dod pa thams cad 'joms par 'gyur ro// khyung nag spu gri 'bar ba'i gdams pa 'di// dam pa sogs kyis bskul phyir rgyal khams pa// blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhes bya bas// legs sbyar dge bas 'gro kun rgyal gyur cig/ ༈ /'di'i sgo nas paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes kyi gsung rab las btus / rang gzhan la bkru byab srung gsum bya bar 'dod na/ bum rdzas nyer lngas bkang ba'i bum pa mchod gtor sogs bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bum pa bsang sbyang spyi ltar bskyed nas lhar gsal gdab/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ ye shes pa bstim/ dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab/

mchod bstod bya/ sngags ring thung gnyis ci nus bzla/ mchod yon phul la bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las bcol/ de nas rang ngam/ bsgrub bya gzhan la bgegs sbyong ba spyi ltar bya/ bum pa'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig par gyur par bsams la/ bkru byab bya/ dri chu dang changs bu lhan cig pa phyir bskyal la bgegs bskrad/ bden stobs brjod pa dang*/ srung ba bya/ shis pa brjod pa rnams spyi ltar sbyar ro// de ltar bgyis pas rang ngam/ gzhan nam/ gnas khang dang*/ yul gru sogs gang la bgyis pa'i grib dang mi gtsang ba dang*/ sa bdag klu gnyan gyi nyer 'tshe sogs zhi bar 'gyur bar nges so// ༈ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ rje blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad/ stegs kyi khar mañji'i steng du zlum gtor dkar po mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed sngar ltar dang*/ mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya/ gtor ma bya rgyud ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum sogs kyis dbul/ mchod cing bstod la gsol ba btab/ slob mas/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol gdab rgyun bshags spyi ltar bya/ slob ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar gyis lhar bskyed/ sku'i rjes gnang zhu ba'i phyir/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dngos// rdo rje mkha' lding nag po yi// sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer las mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khyung nag gi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad de'i sku'i rnam pa dpag tu med par spyan drangs nas slob ma khyed rang rnams la thim pas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag

sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ma lus sems can kun gyi zhes sogs sh+lo ka'i rjes su/ e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes mang du brjod/ gsung gi rjes gnang la/ gong gi gsol 'debs kyi sku'i zhes par gsung gi zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig byung ba zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ snying gar 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyis ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags gnyis ka lan gsum re'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ gsol 'debs kyi tshig thugs zhes bsgyur nas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rdo rje khyung nag gi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad sa bon hūm̐ yig dang*/ khyung rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i lus dang nye ba na bdud rtsi sna lnga'i rnam par zhu ba lus la thim pas yid kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad byang zhing dag thugs kyi byin rlabs thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags brjod cing rol mo dkrol/ lha bstim pa'i rjes gnang la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha spyan drangs/ slob ma'i spyi bor bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma slob ma'i mgor bzhag la bka' bsgo spyi 'gro ltar byas mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas de dgyes bzhin du rang 'dra gnyis pa zhig thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/

lha zhu ba'i gtor zan/ dam rdzas 'chi med bdud rtsi'i zas// snying po 'dus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis za bar bya// 'di zos rdo rje mkha' lding gi// zhal zas bsten na nad gdon las// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// zhes pas sbyin/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi ltar sbyar ro// sarba maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /'di'i sgo nas srung 'khor 'bri na/ bsnyen pa sngon du song bas lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms la/ rgya shog gtsang mar rgya snag gis 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad lte ba dang mu khyud nyis rim bcas pa bri/ lte bar hūm̐/ de'i mdun nas brtsams te/ 'chang ba po'i lus ngag yid gsum la gdon bgegs 'byung po'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ rtsibs brgyad la hūm̐ brgyad/ mu khyud nang ma la ming spel tshig dang bcas pa/ phyi mar rten snying gi mthar ming spel tshig bcas g.yas skor du bri/ mtha' me ris bskor/ 'khor lo dang srung chings bcas 'bru tshom gyi steng du bzhag la bsang sbyang*/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo gzhal yas khang dang hūm̐ rnams khyung nag skud pa rnams rigs lngar bskyed bstim dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod bzlas pa bcas bya/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ ming spel bsgrub bya dngos su gsal ba la/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis reg pas nad gdon sdig sgrib gang gis kyang mi tshugs par bsrungs shing byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rang sngags dang rten snying gis rab tu gnas shing me tog 'thor/ gzhal yas khang 'khor lo dang*/ lha rnams yig 'bru/ bsrung bya ming yig rigs lnga rnams skud pa'i rnam par bsams la shis pa brjod/ srung chings lte ba sngon po dang gzhan mdzes tshon du spel la dkris nas bsgril tshas sngon po dang bcas gdags pas nad gdon bar chad kun thub kyi srung ba'o// de las gzhan yang bye brag tu rta phyugs srung ba/ rgyal btsan dang gza' klu'i gnod pa srung ba/

bsod nams dpal skyed/ srid spel ba sogs la spel tshig ji ltar rigs pa kha bsgyur te bgyis pas rung zhing*/ za yig byed na/ rgya shog la rgya snag gis sngags tshan gnyis po tshag med yig phreng gcig tu bris/ yig 'bru rnams khyung du bskyed bstim sogs bgyis rjes yig 'bru'i rnam par bsams la gza' la mgo dang*/ gzhan la mjug nas bsgril/ rtse gsum gyis ma reg par zos pas snying gar slebs pa na khyung nag me 'bar bar gyur te nad gdon thams cad bsregs par bsam mo// 'dis nad gdon gang la'ang phan zhing*/ khyad par gdon rigs kyi gdon pa la zab ces gsungs so// gzhan la srung ba byed na/ rang khyung du gsal ba dang*/ bsgrub bya gnyis ka'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gsal gdab/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge las 'od 'phros/ bsrung bya'i gnas gsum gyi yig 'bru la phog de las 'od 'phros sgo gsum gyi gdon bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam/ bsrung bya me'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la sngags mchil gdam pa sogs ji ltar rigs par bya'o// zhes pa'ang yig rnying dang gu ge yongs 'dzin gyi zin bris las btus pa dge /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
